research_question: When an agent benchmark score changes, when should the change be attributed to the agent and when to the harness, tool schema, configuration, provider, environment, or evaluator contract?
decision_owner: Benchmark maintainers and system selectors deciding which component to compare, repair, or deploy.
worlds: W1: The agent's decision policy or capability changed under an otherwise equivalent execution contract.
W2: Harness, configuration, schema, provider, website, locale, or evaluator drift changed the measured behavior.
W3: Replay or judge noise creates an apparent attribution without a stable intervention target.
discriminator: A revision-pinned cross-harness replay matrix with frozen agent, benchmark items, tools, provider snapshot, evaluator, and environment where one contract component changes at a time and outcomes retain trace-level confidence intervals.
falsifier: Score differences disappear under a frozen contract, fail to reproduce across replay, or cannot be localized beyond stochastic/judge uncertainty.
scope: Method-free R0 problem framing; any benchmark, replay system, or visualization is an instrument.
does_not_establish: Review-only source reduction; no gap, novelty, prevalence, proposal, or lifecycle transition is established.

source_spans.title: AgentBeats: Agentifying Agent Assessment for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility
source_spans.observation: Separates benchmark and subject agents and shows harness swapping changes results.
source_spans.resolves: A full-stack evaluation decomposition and measured harness sensitivity.
source_spans.does_not_establish: Causal attribution for arbitrary deployments or reproducibility from openness alone.

source_spans.title: Causal Agent Replay: Counterfactual Attribution for LLM-Agent Failures
source_spans.observation: Provides intervention-based step attribution but only with mocked tools and synthetic ground truth.
source_spans.resolves: A causal replay instrument and its validity boundary.
source_spans.leaves_unresolved: Live side-effecting replay and general field attribution.
source_spans.does_not_establish: Faithful replay of live side-effecting tools or a field-level causal attribution result.

source_spans.title: AgentLab reproducibility documentation
source_spans.observation: Enumerates concrete reproducibility drift sources and records versions/commits.
source_spans.resolves: A primary workflow pressure and inspection mechanism.
source_spans.leaves_unresolved: Effect sizes or a complete replay guarantee.
source_spans.does_not_establish: The size of each effect or a universal replay contract.

source_spans.title: ClawBench/ShellBench reproducibility-first benchmark release
source_spans.observation: Treats harness, configuration, and model as a versioned full stack.
source_spans.resolves: An operational alternative to model-only scoring.
source_spans.leaves_unresolved: Independent scientific validation or human calibration.
source_spans.does_not_establish: Scientific validation of its diagnostics, broad human calibration, or causal attribution.

derived_questions.question: Which minimal execution-contract fields reverse a benchmark comparison when pinned or changed?
derived_questions.smallest_discriminator: One agent-task pair replayed across two harnesses with every other revision fixed.

derived_questions.question: Can a trace-level intervention localize a score change without oracle substitution or transcript judging?
derived_questions.smallest_discriminator: One mocked replay with known commitment point followed by one explicitly non-adjudicated live-tool feasibility check.

controller_boundary: Independent review is required before any route or promotion decision.
